evidence.dominant_driver: Trump said there is 'a lot of momentum' for an Iran deal and expects Iran to 'do something good', reinforcing the same-day direct-talks de-escalation cluster without announcing an agreement.

market_expectations.source: same-day US-Iran diplomacy and oil pricing
market_expectations.expected_value: Markets already priced substantial de-escalation through lower oil, lower yields and strong tech; the new remarks strengthen the probability of continued talks but do not establish a deal.
market_expectations.distribution_notes: Incremental confirmation, not an independent shock.

absorption.reason: The update arrived after oil had already fallen below $100 Brent and Nasdaq had reached an intraday record on diplomacy hopes; residual move should therefore be smaller.

observations.interpretation: Oil, yields, volatility and gold broadly confirm de-escalation/risk-on, though much predates this incremental quote.

evidence.decision_notes: Residual forecast only. Learning profile ACTIONABLE model-2 directional 1h confidence 5-6 is REDUCE_OR_AVOID, so otherwise-5/10 1h directional calls were capped at 4/10; no direction was changed by learning.
